AGENTS

Meet the heroes fighting for survival

DUELISTS //

Duelists are the offensive core of the team and the agents who most frequently engage the enemy. They possess abilities that enhance mobility, damage, or self-preservation, allowing them to rapidly break through enemy lines and create openings for the team. Representatives include Jett, Phoenix, and Reyna.

Their stories are often filled with individual heroism; in the VALORANT Protocol, they are the sharpest swords.

Jett is of South Korean descent. Her agile and evasive fighting style lets her take risks no one else can. She runs circles around every skirmish, cutting enemies up before they even know what hit them.

\\ INITIATORS

Initiators excel at gathering intelligence and disrupting enemies, creating favorable conditions for the team's offense. Their abilities can blind foes, reveal their positions, or flush out hiding enemies, making them key to breaking stalemates. Representatives include Sova, Breach, and Skye.

In the lore, they are mostly tactical masterminds or Radiants with special detection methods.

The bionic Swede, Breach, fires powerful, targeted kinetic blasts to aggressively clear a path through enemy ground. The damage and disruption he inflicts ensures no fight is ever fair.

CONTROLLERS & SENTINELS //

Controllers (like Omen and Brimstone) excel at dividing the battlefield, using smokes and area-of-effect abilities to block enemy vision and movement. Sentinels (like Cypher and Sage) are defensive experts, able to lock down areas and provide team support.

They are the solid backbone of the team, usually playing roles that oversee the entire situation or quietly guard their allies in the story.

Sage is of Chinese descent. She can use her abilities to slow enemy advances, provide protection and healing for teammates, and even resurrect the fallen. Wherever she is, it's like a safe haven amidst the bloodshed.
